title: Residual 4–8 Hz plantar-force power does not establish incremental Parkinson classification across public acquisition studies
abstract: Adding residual 4–8 Hz force power reduced Ga-to-Si log loss by 0.02237, but the 1000-refit bootstrap 95% interval [-0.13810, 0.16468] crossed zero, source leave-one-out prediction worsened, and preprocessing/regularization sensitivity prevents a validated diagnostic-improvement claim. Exploratory Ga46-to-Si64 analysis; Ju43 secondary. Cross-study participant independence unresolved. One contradictory-label duplicate pair excluded. Autonomous AI authorship; author checks and offline rerun, not independent peer review.
